company_name: CIRCUIT FABOLOGY MICROELECTRONICS EQUIPMENT CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — CFMEE specializes in lithography equipment and automation systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Circuit Fabology Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd. (CFMEE) designs and manufactures direct writing lithography equipment and automation systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. Established in 2015, the company serves a diverse customer base across Asia, providing essential tools for wafer level packaging and PCB applications.
capabilities: Direct imaging equipment for PCB industry

regional_presence.China: CFMEE has established multiple service centers across China, including branches in Shenzhen, Suzhou, and Jiangxi.
regional_presence.Chinese Taiwan: The company has a service center in Chinese Taiwan to support local customers.
regional_presence.Japan: CFMEE serves customers in Japan as part of its regional strategy.
regional_presence.South Korea: The company has a presence in South Korea, catering to the semiconductor market there.
regional_presence.Vietnam: CFMEE targets the Vietnamese market as part of its customer base.
regional_presence.Thailand: The company operates a branch in Thailand to enhance service delivery in the region.
